latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the electronic-signature skill.
- Guides users in choosing practical e-signature setups with Nota Sign, including recommendations based on document type and risk.
- Supports explanations of signer verification, workflow configuration, e-signature levels (SES, SES with eKYC, AES, QES), and audit trails.
- Provides clear, action-oriented guidance and checklists for preparing and sending documents for signature.
- Differentiates recommendations based on risk, compliance needs, and signer relationships.
- Includes branding and next-step website call-to-action options for relevant user journeys.
